entity: 5th Circuit cases at the Supreme Court that were federal-government appeals, 2021-24 vs 2015-20
what_we_add: 16 of 38 5th Circuit Supreme Court cases in 2021-24 were federal-government appeals vs 1 of 26 in 2015-20; other 11 circuits flat at about 12%; Supreme Court cases per 1,000 5th Circuit appeals 0.57 to 1.50
why: SCOTUSblog 2023 reports federal agencies repeatedly asking the Court to reverse 5th Circuit rulings; Bloomberg Law calls the 5th Circuit a Supreme Court outlier. Same direction, but only in words or other measures; no source has the before/after count. Reversal-rate and case-count sources (3, 4, 5) measure other things and don't contradict it.
